name: io.github.blurxy/py-exec-mcp
description: Run Python from an MCP client without a shell mangling your code: code goes to the interpreter over stdin.

environmentVariables.name: PY_EXEC_CWD
environmentVariables.description: Directory code runs in, also prepended to PYTHONPATH. Defaults to the server's cwd.

environmentVariables.name: PY_EXEC_PYTHON
environmentVariables.description: Interpreter to run code with. Defaults to the project's .venv, else the server's interpreter.

environmentVariables.name: PY_EXEC_MAX_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: Upper clamp on timeout_s in seconds. Default 600.

environmentVariables.name: PY_EXEC_MAX_OUTPUT
environmentVariables.description: Per-stream character cap before the middle of the output is cut. Default 30000.
